acceptanceCriteria: Done by #1278 (V1-2006, PWP-V0-035..038): the 1.64.0 tuples are admitted, including Node v24.11.1 for /0 and /3, and an e2e refusal exits 3 with one stderr line (#1275).
Receipts and freshness admit from ONE shared exact-tuple table (exact Node patch, runner version, browser source, per decision 0448); freshness on Playwright 1.64.0 is admitted only with a live run.
A refusal document names the failing tuple field (node, runner or browser source) and the admitted values.
Node major/minor ranges (the #1270 request) stay unadmitted unless the owner amends decision 0448; until then #1270 is answered with Refs, not Closes.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1270: the receipt (internal/jstestprovider external.go qualifiedNodeVersion) and freshness (freshness.go Node v22.23.3 + runner 1.63.0) pins are exact patch versions that exclude each other; Node 24 LTS and Playwright 1.64.0 can never qualify. #1275: admission refusals share the exit status of run failures and write nothing on stderr. Folded into the V1-2006 lane (PWP-V0 range).
title: JS test provider: one declared runtime tuple set for receipts and freshness, plus a distinct admission-refusal exit code (GitHub #1270, #1275)
